title: nan
authors: Moussa M.; Zahran S.; Mostafa M.; Moussa A.; El-Sheimy N.; Elhabiby M.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated aiding navigation system using optical flow and mass flow sensors to aid low-cost INS in GNSS-denied indoor underground parking environments, validated experimentally for land vehicles.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
